Esto solo ocurre cuando tocas subir; no se envía nada de forma automática.

video_shader_preset_mode_c_hq: Alta calidad para anime SD antiguo (480p) con manchas de compresión. Necesita una GPU potente.

video_quality_enhancement_hint: Actívalo para nitidez de imagen con el escalado de alta calidad integrado en mpv. Funciona tanto en anime como en series y películas de acción real. Para ir más allá con shaders como Anime4K, abre Mejora de imagen mientras se reproduce un vídeo y elige un nivel allí.
reader_image_file_unavailable: El archivo de imagen no está disponible.
video_shader_import_from_mpv_hint: 自动搜索本机 mpv；未找到时可手动选择 mpv 目录。
video_shader_first_use_title: 试试 Anime4K 画质增强
video_shader_first_use_body: 想让动画画面更清晰，可以进入“画质增强”并点击“下载 Anime4K 推荐着色器”。下载后在已安装列表里勾选即可启用。
sync_err_invalid_client: Las credenciales del cliente no son válidas para esta versión: actualiza la app.
sync_err_not_configured: Las credenciales de sincronización de Google no están configuradas en esta versión.
floating_lyric_unavailable_hint: No se pudo mostrar la ventana de subtítulo flotante.
video_shader_tier_off_hint: Sin mejora. Reproduce el vídeo original tal cual.
video_shader_tier_low_hint: Nitidez integrada de mpv (ewa_lanczossharp). Funciona en cualquier vídeo (animación y acción real). Sin descargas, mínima carga de GPU. Elige esta opción en gráficas integradas o antiguas (NVIDIA GTX 1050, AMD RX 560, iGPU de Intel).
video_shader_tier_medium_hint: Anime4K Fast. Lo mejor para animación, pero también sirve para películas/series de acción real (mejora menor). Funciona en GPU de gama media (NVIDIA GTX 1660 / RTX 3050, AMD RX 6600).
video_shader_tier_high_hint: Anime4K HQ. Más nítido; lo mejor para animación, también utilizable en acción real (mejora menor). Necesita una GPU de gama media-alta (NVIDIA RTX 4060 / RTX 3070, AMD RX 6700 XT / RX 7700 XT).
video_shader_tier_ultra_hint: Anime4K Mode A (UL, red ultra grande). La reconstrucción Anime4K más potente; también utilizable en acción real (mejora menor). Necesita una GPU tope de gama (NVIDIA RTX 4080 / RTX 5090, AMD RX 7900 XTX). Elige un nivel inferior si tu GPU es más débil.
video_shader_tier_custom_hint: Selección de shaders personalizada. Elige un nivel arriba para volver a un preset.
video_shader_mobile_perf_hint: En teléfonos, los shaders solo se aplican en la ruta de renderizado de GPU estándar y su eficacia varía según la GPU del dispositivo; los niveles más altos pueden provocar caídas de fotogramas o calentamiento. Prueba primero Baja/Media y comprueba el resultado en tu dispositivo.

manga_remote_ocr_unsupported: The paired host does not support manga OCR.
manga_remote_ocr_no_host: No paired host with manga OCR is reachable.
manga_remote_ocr_cancelled: Remote OCR was cancelled on the host.
manga_rescan_model_missing: Recognition model not downloaded. Download it in Settings > Manga OCR.
manga_rescan_mode_hint: Drag to select an area to recognise
manga_cloud_ocr_privacy: When you tap Cloud retry, the selected image area is sent to the Google Gemini API with your own API key. Nothing is uploaded unless you trigger it manually.
manga_ocr_mobile_note: On mobile, the recognition model powers box scan in the manga reader.
games_already_added: This game is already in the library
games_drop_no_exe: No new game .exe among the dropped files
game_hook_recapture_started: Recording — replay this line in the game
game_hook_recapture_saved: Recaptured voice saved to this line
game_hook_recapture_empty: No audio captured in the recapture window
game_hook_recapture_unavailable: Voice recapture needs system loopback audio
anki_duplicate_scope_hint: Which decks are searched when checking whether a card already exists. AnkiConnect only; AnkiDroid always searches the whole collection.
shortcut_press_wheel: Hold a modifier key and scroll here
shortcut_wheel_needs_modifier: A bare wheel scrolls the popup — hold Alt / Ctrl / Shift while scrolling
shortcut_scope_dictionary_popup_note: Works while the pointer is over a dictionary popup
game_hook_reason_helper_missing: Voice-hook helper is not installed for this game architecture; install it and try again.
game_hook_reason_target_missing: No game process or executable was selected for capture.
game_hook_reason_spawn_failed: The helper could not be started; check that antivirus has not removed or blocked it.
game_hook_reason_bitness_mismatch: Helper architecture does not match the game (32-bit vs 64-bit); reinstall the helper.
game_hook_reason_access_denied: The game runs with higher privileges; start Hibiki as administrator and try again.
game_hook_reason_elevation_required: This game requires administrator rights; start Hibiki as administrator and launch it again.
game_hook_reason_create_process_failed: The game could not be started from Hibiki; check the executable path.
game_hook_reason_hook_dll_missing: The helper package is incomplete (hook library missing); reinstall it.
game_hook_reason_game_exe_missing: The game executable no longer exists at the saved path.
game_hook_reason_stale_session: A previous capture session is still loaded in the game; restart the game once.
game_hook_reason_ready_timeout: The hook library did not finish loading in time; antivirus scanning can cause this.
game_hook_reason_injection_failed: Injection into the game was blocked; add Hibiki and the game to antivirus exclusions.
game_hook_reason_guarded_hook_failed: A profile-guarded hook could not be installed in time; retrying automatically.
game_hook_reason_resume_failed: The launched game could not be resumed and was stopped; launch it again.
game_hook_reason_steam_timeout: Steam accepted the launch request but the game process never appeared.
game_hook_reason_shared_memory_unavailab: The capture channel could not be opened; restart Hibiki.
game_hook_reason_handshake_timeout: The game was hooked but produced no text or audio in time; this engine may not be supported yet.
video_setting_auto_scrape_hint: Silently fetch cover, synopsis, rating and tags from Bangumi for videos in your library
video_scrape_info_empty: No series info yet. It is fetched automatically in the background; you can also match it manually.
games_no_match: No games match the current filters
game_detail_missing: This game is no longer in the library
game_summary_none: No description yet. Fetch metadata to fill it in.
stat_goal_scope_hint: Counts all characters combined: reading + video subtitles + game text.
data_root_unavailable_message: Your configured data location $path is temporarily unreachable (the drive may be asleep, busy, or disconnected). Your data is safe and untouched there — nothing is lost. Tap Retry once the drive is ready to load your data, or start with the default location for now (your existing data will NOT be modified).
browser_extension_version_mismatch: The extension loaded in your browser is outdated. Prepare the extension again if needed, then reload it from your browser's extensions page (chrome://extensions).
book_scrape_search_failed: Search failed. Tap Search to retry.
anime_download_search_error_proxy_hint: If the site cannot be reached directly, configure a network proxy in download settings.
audio_source_edit_target_gone: That audio source no longer exists — edit discarded
game_capture_degraded_loopback: The game is running, but engine injection failed; falling back to system audio, which can mix in BGM and effects.
game_capture_window_missing: The game process started but its window never appeared, so the game may not have launched. Try starting it again.
